reason: Measure the essential equipment's load before arranging reserve power.
expectation: The meter should show the panel's load, though I don't know yet how reserve runtime will be determined.

alternatives.reason: Preparing the carrier also serves a goal, but the flashing supply warning makes the power measurement my priority.

effect: The measured load includes cycling peaks, so the reserve setup must support more than the average draw.
reaction: The distinction between peak and average load is useful.
reason: Connect the charged reserve battery to the measured panel to assess the backup setup.
expectation: I expect the battery and measured load to yield a reserve-power assessment or setup, though the switch and power unit may still be needed.

alternatives.reason: The carrier also needs preparation, but I want to continue addressing the power warning first.

effect: The measured essential load gives an estimated reserve duration past dawn with a margin, provided the load does not increase.
reaction: The estimate feels more useful with its limits and next check stated.
reason: Continue the reserve setup by adding the enclosed switch to the load-based estimate.
expectation: I expect this to prepare a controlled changeover to reserve power; the backup power unit may still be needed.

alternatives.reason: The carrier still needs preparation, but I want to finish the reserve setup first.

effect: The approved switch isolates the essential circuits, keeping nonessential advertisements off the reserve load.
reaction: The advertisements going dark makes the tradeoff concrete.
reason: Add the matched backup power unit to continue the reserve setup.
expectation: I expect the unit to connect or prepare backup power for the isolated circuits; the cooler may still need a separate check.

alternatives.reason: The carrier also needs preparation, but I want to finish the reserve setup first.

effect: The backup unit is connected to the essential circuits but still needs its battery.
reaction: The distinction between a connected route and an actual power source is clear.
reason: Connect the charged battery to supply the essential circuits.
expectation: I expect reserve power to become available, though the cooler may still need a separate check.

alternatives.reason: The carrier needs preparation too, but I want to finish the reserve connection first.

effect: The reserve feed now supplies the isolated essential circuit, using the battery's stored energy.
reaction: The reminder that reserve power buys time rather than creating energy is clear.
reason: Connect the monitored cooler to the reserve feed to check the essential backup arrangement.
expectation: I expect the cooler to run on reserve power under independent monitoring, though a further check may be needed.

alternatives.reason: The carrier also needs preparation, but I want to verify the cooler's reserve supply first.

effect: The cooler survived the transfer to reserve power under monitoring, completing the reserve-power goal.
reaction: Eli's relief makes the successful changeover feel consequential.
reason: The carrier is the remaining goal, and fitting its jacket is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the jacket to insulate the transport crate; the thermal packs will likely still need to be added.

effect: The crate is insulated, including its lid; the thermal packs are the remaining offered step.
reaction: Covering the often-forgotten lid is a useful detail.
reason: Add the prepared thermal packs to finish preparing the cold carrier; this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect a cold carrier ready for the next collection, though its safe holding duration is not stated.

effect: The carrier now has prepared thermal packs and handling rules, completing the remaining goal without implying indefinite cold storage.
reaction: The stated limit makes the completed carrier feel credible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Transferring the cooler to monitored reserve power was most worthwhile: the check confirmed that cooling survived the changeover, and Eli's relief made the result consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive reserve-power connections felt somewhat repetitive, even though each had a clear role.

surprise.text: The measured load's cycling peaks mattered alongside its average, and the reserve estimate depended on not adding more load.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the switch, backup unit and battery had distinct purposes, although their separate combinations made the sequence feel drawn out.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the practical details and the clinic's situation made the outcome engaging, though I would hope for more varied decisions than the sequential connections.
